title: Venezuelan-Style Bowl with Floral Chia Seeds
description: A hearty, vegan bowl filled with the flavors of Venezuela and topped with a nutritious floral chia seed crunch.

ingredients.name: chicken
ingredients.notes: Note: omitted chicken as per vegan diet

instructions: 1. Rinse the chia seeds and soak them in water for 5 minutes.
2. Cook the quinoa according to the package instructions.
3. Cook the black beans and mash them.
4. Roast the sweet potato in the oven at 400°F (200°C) for 45 minutes.
5. In a large bowl, combine the cooked quinoa, black beans, and roasted sweet potato.
6. Top the bowl with the soaked chia seeds.
7. Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve immediately.
